resources.string: Bluetooth scanning is needed to find your EMG sensor.
Bluetooth connection is needed to receive EMG and IMU data from your sensor.
Location permission is required by Android to scan for Bluetooth devices nearby.

ATHLETE EMG — PRIVACY POLICY
 Last updated: June 2026

 Athlete EMG is developed by SafeStrongSport, a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization (EIN 99-2750707).

 WHAT DATA WE COLLECT
 The app collects EMG (electromyography) and IMU (motion) sensor data from a Bluetooth LE wearable device worn on your forearm during tennis sessions. This data is used solely to compute forearm muscle fatigue metrics on your device.

 STORAGE
 All sensor data and session history are stored locally on your device only. No data is transmitted to any server. No account or login is required.

 BLUETOOTH
 The app scans for and connects to Bluetooth LE devices nearby. This requires the BLUETOOTH_SCAN and BLUETOOTH_CONNECT permissions on Android 12+, and ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION on earlier versions. These permissions are used only to find and connect to your EMG sensor.

 CHILDREN
 This app is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect personal information from them.

 CHANGES
 We may update this policy. The current version is always available at safestrongsport.org and within the app.
